title: spec: kanban.lanes TSDoc still says the board ignores the key; lint checkKanbanLanes docblock owes its option-map line
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzC6RxMfB59EsgAoNN

Filing gate: ② a named follow-up from the contract-review PASS record 6538743783 on PR #28291 (#28211), boundary flag "stale spec text". The seat committed to filing it in claim amendment 6537973671 and the PR body.
Business reason: `kanban.lanes` is now live. #28291 (merged `85a1b9d8`) draws only the declared lanes, in the author's order. But the key's TSDoc still tells authors and the generated docs that the board ignores it. An author who reads the reference would think the key does nothing and won't use it. The lint docblock also does not say that a future widening of inline options must join its option map, which was review rider S2 on #28211.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` (spec TSDoc plus one `packages/lint` docblock line). No behaviour change.
Duplicate search: open issues with "kanban lanes TSDoc" or "Lands ahead of its reader kanban" found none. **New.**

## Observed (on `origin/main` `85a1b9d8`)

1. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2097`, in the `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` TSDoc: "Lands ahead of its reader: the board draws one lane per option until the console half reads this key where it builds its lanes." This has been false since #28291. The liveness `view.json` `kanban` row already says `lanes` is live.
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`: the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock (around :1082) has no line saying that a future widening of the inline options a `groupByField` may carry must join the option map `checkKanbanLanes` reads. Rider S2 of review 6528382115 on #28211 asked for that line.

## Wanted

- Drop or rewrite the "Lands ahead of its reader" paragraph so it states what is drawn: listed lanes in order, and an unlisted value lands in `Uncategorized`. Check the `.describe()` text for the same clause, then regenerate whatever reference pages `check:generated` names.
- Add the S2 line to the `checkKanbanLanes` docblock.
- Patch changeset if the gate demands one. Clause-② no.

Related: #28211, #28018, PR #28291.
